layer_order: incident face to rigid rear wall
air_source: Frozen case conditions copied from physics_constants.toml; pressure, gamma and Pr from pinned tmm._utils.AirProperties(20 C, RH 30%, 101325 Pa).
coverage_notes: 1/24 octave 20-8000 Hz, with explicit endpoints. All four circular panel methods, all generic end corrections including aliases/default, ordinary and microperforation geometry, both geometric and explicit open area.
constant_z is a direct impedance termination in the source, represented by a rank-one terminal matrix in the JAX API; it is not a pressure-jump sheet.

The source eq_fluid implementation ignores rho despite its general documentation. Frozen rho cases preserve that behavior; other methods use the original parallel mass path and solid/full-surface conventions.
All facing methods/aliases, default estimates and explicit parameters; slot barrier is the only source slot method. Low/high membrane and plate mass, and all four requested stacks.
Direct circular pore properties, including deprecated open_area impedance scaling, are frozen separately from layer spectra.
